module.name: Samsung power (WebSocket API)
module.description: Drives a 2023 Samsung Tizen TV through the local WebSocket API.

host.title: TV IP address
host.description: Address of the TV on the local network.

mac.title: MAC address
mac.description: MAC of the TV network interface, for Wake-on-LAN (Ethernet preferred).

port.title: WebSocket port
port.description: TLS port of the API (8002 by default).

name.title: Name shown on the TV
name.description: Device name shown when authorising on the TV.

unreachable_means_off.title: Unreachable means off
unreachable_means_off.description: Treat the TV as off when it stops answering on the network.

samsung.accept_on_tv: Accept the connection request displayed on the TV.
